title_en: Chinese Companies (20/20): The Rise and Fall of the Real Estate Industry
note_en: 当 introduces the time or situation in which the main action happens, like English "when": 但当市场增速放缓，一些…开发商便开始出现资金困难 "But when the market's growth slowed, some developers began to run short of cash." It is often closed with 时 or 的时候 (当…时), and the main clause frequently picks up with 就 or its formal equivalent 便, as here.
